data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and order (open map search, type the origin and pick the airport, search, open the results list), but it invents trip_type and max_price parameters, leaves out search_type, and treats "flexible dates" as a vague date_mode setting, so it is only partly automatable from the spec alone.
